metadata.description: Evidence-first extraction from conversations, tickets and meetings

containsMessage.description: Identifies a message occurrence contained in the conversation or meeting record; each message occurrence belongs to at most one conversation.

authoredBy.description: Attributes a message to its recorded author or speaker. Authorship does not imply decision authority or agreement with quoted content.

discusses.description: Identifies a topic discussed in a conversation; discussion alone does not establish a proposal, decision or action.

recordedIn.description: Identifies the conversation in which a decision or action item was recorded; recording does not establish acceptance or completion.

assignedTo.description: Identifies the actor assigned responsibility for an action item; assignment does not establish acceptance, execution or completion.

tracks.description: Identifies an action item tracked by a ticket; the records remain distinct and the link does not imply completion.

statedIn.description: Identifies a message in which a claim is stated or quoted; attribution records what was said, not the truth of the claim or the speaker's endorsement.

decidedBy.description: Identifies an actor explicitly recorded as making or adopting the decision; merely proposing, speaking, recording it or receiving an assignment does not establish decision authority.
